duration: 2–4 horas (recolha de itens + 2 horas de espera)
summary: Em Rookgaard podes ganhar os dois addons do outfit Citizen, os mesmos que se ganham no continente. A {npc:Norma} ensina-te a fazer o chapéu com penas em troca de penas de galinha, favos de mel e um capacete, e a {npc:Amber} faz-te a mochila com 100 peças de couro de minotauro.
legend_pt: Os mesmos addons que se ganham no continente.

start.label: Norma, a norte da Academia de Rookgaard

requirements: Sem nível mínimo (recomendado nível 6+ para os minotauros).
O outfit Citizen já está disponível para todos os jogadores: esta quest só dá os addons.

items_needed.note: chapéu; troca um present com o Seymour

rewards.text: Addon 2 do Citizen: chapéu com pena (Norma)

tips: Junta todos os itens antes de falares com as NPCs.

Os {item:Chicken Feather|Chicken Feathers} caem de {creature:Chicken|Chickens}, os {item:Honeycomb|Honeycombs} de {creature:Wasp|Wasps} e/ou {creature:Bear|Bears}, e o {item:Minotaur Leather} de {creature:Minotaur|Minotaurs}.
Entrega o couro à Amber primeiro: ela demora 2 horas a fazer a mochila e podes tratar do chapéu entretanto.

steps.title: Arranjar o Legion Helmet
steps.text: Vai à Academia de Rookgaard e troca um {item:Present|present} pelo {item:Legion Helmet} com o {npc:Seymour}.

steps.title: Juntar as penas e os favos
steps.text: Mata {creature:Chicken|galinhas} até teres 100 {item:Chicken Feather|Chicken Feathers} e {creature:Wasp|vespas} e/ou {creature:Bear|ursos} até teres 50 {item:Honeycomb|Honeycombs}.

steps.title: Pedir o chapéu à Norma
steps.text: Vai à loja da {npc:Norma}, logo a **norte** da Academia. Diz {key:hi}, {key:hat} e {key:yes}.

dialogue.npc: Welcome, welcome! Have a seat! If you like a drink or something to eat, just ask me for a trade!
Pretty, isn't it? I made it myself, but I could teach you how to do that if you like. What do you say?
Okay, here we go, listen closely! I need a few things... a basic hat of course, maybe a legion helmet would do. Then about 100 chicken feathers... and 50 honeycombs as glue. [...]

steps.title: Entregar os itens
steps.text: Com tudo no inventário, volta à Norma e diz {key:hi}, {key:hat} e {key:yes}. Ela faz-te o chapéu.

dialogue.npc: Oh, you're back already? Did you bring a legion helmet, 100 chicken feathers and 50 honeycombs?
Great job! That must have taken a lot of work. Okay, you put it like this... then glue like this... here!

steps.title: Pedir a mochila à Amber
steps.text: Desce à sala de descanso (Resting Room) debaixo da Academia e fala com a {npc:Amber}. Diz {key:hi}, {key:addon}, {key:minotaur leather} e {key:yes}.

coords.label: Amber, Resting Room debaixo da Academia

dialogue.npc: Oh hello, nice to see you Player. Are you here to hear some stories of my adventures or do you need help?
Ah, you noticed my new accessory? Sorry, this one is not for sale. It's handmade from rare minotaur leather.
Well, if you really like this backpack, I could make one for you, but minotaur leather is hard to come by these days. Are you willing to put some work into this?
Alright then, if you bring me 100 pieces of fine minotaur leather I will see what I can do for you. [...]

steps.title: Entregar o couro
steps.text: Com o couro no inventário, diz {key:hi}, {key:backpack} e {key:yes}.

dialogue.npc: Ah, right, almost forgot about the backpack! Have you brought me 100 pieces of minotaur leather as requested?
Great! Alright, I need a while to finish this backpack for you. Come ask me later, okay?

steps.title: Voltar 2 horas depois
steps.text: Espera **2 horas**, volta à Amber e diz {key:hi} e {key:addon}. Ela dá-te a mochila.

dialogue.npc: Just in time! Your backpack is finished. Here you go, I hope you like it.
